vulnerabilities.description: The retry controls own separate cell and snapshot errors, but both call continuation helpers with terminal/uninitialized guards. After an initial snapshot page fails, claimsHasMore is false and loadMoreClaims() returns without retrying. After a dedicated cell page-zero failure over an existing snapshot fragment, loadMoreCellClaims() returns because the cell page is not initialized. Closing/reopening the claim or cell can recover, but the displayed retry itself is a no-op.

edgeCasesMissed: Fail the initial tenant snapshot page before hasMore is established and assert the snapshot retry explicitly repeats cursor zero.
Fail the dedicated cell cursor-zero request when a snapshot fragment already exists and assert the cell retry repeats cursor zero rather than requiring initialized continuation state.
Resolve different history cursor flights out of order during a route reset and prove an older continuation cannot overwrite the reset cursor or hasMore state.
Add an interaction-level browser test that traverses more than one cell page and more than one reverse-reference page, rather than validating only projection/control helpers.
topFinding: All prior HIGH defects are fixed; the remaining issue is a medium-severity mismatch where initial-load retry buttons call continuation functions whose guards can suppress the retry.

impact.rationale: Normal bounded traversal, isolation, stale-generation rejection, and multi-page reachability remain functional. A transient failure on an initial cell or snapshot page can leave the visible retry inert, but reopening the affected view restarts the request.
